author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: "पाञ्चजन्यम्" इति । "हृषीकेश"‍शब्दार्थ उक्तो भाष्ये एकादशे,  "हृषीकाणामिन्द्रियानामीशत्वाच्च हृशीकेश" (गीताभाष्य ११.३६) इत्यादि ।  "दध्मौ" इत्यन्वयः
translation: Hrishikesa (the ruler of the senses) blew his Panchajanya and Dhananjaya his Devadatta; Vrikodara (Bhima) of terrible deeds blew his mighty conch Poundra. (15)
